1.title: Platner Faces Growing Democratic Calls to Drop Out
1.summary: Even supporters like Representative Ro Khanna of California and Senator Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts called on the Democratic nominee to exit the Maine Senate race after a report that he had sexually assaulted a woman.

2.title: In CNN Interview, Woman Details Alleged Sexual Assault by Graham Platner
2.summary: “This is something that I tried for many years to forget,” the woman, Jenny Racicot, said on CNN.

3.title: The World Cup Revived Seattle’s Downtown. Will the Energy Last?
3.summary: The city struggled for years after the pandemic shutdown and the rush to remote work. But downtown has been full of soccer fans for the past month.

4.title: Resistance and revenge - Iran wanted to send a message with its farewell to Khamenei
4.summary: Three days of public mourning in Tehran was a political spectacle Iran's leaders wanted the world to see, writes the BBC's international correspondent Lyse Doucet.

5.title: Jailers and officials at Russia's 'torture prisons' in Ukraine exposed by BBC
5.summary: Former prisoners accuse the men of abuse in detention centres and want to see them brought to trial.

6.title: Fatigue, Tension, Joy: England Pulls a World Cup All-Nighter
6.summary: The game against Mexico started at 2 a.m. in Britain. Pubs were allowed to stay open unusually late for fans to share the drama together.
